name: Chaise lounge facing the window, a reading corner left of the window, KALLAX play wall with Maddie's reading chair
notes:
Alternative: No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
A lounge layout: the KIVIK with chaise floats with its back to the open side and faces the window, the chaise on the right end toward the play area, with the LACK console behind it; no coffee table (the chaise is the footrest). The window's left corner is a grown-up reading corner (POÄNG and TÅGARP), and the play wall is KALLAX: a 2x4 on the upper section, a 2x2 with drawer inserts in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, and Maddie's own reading corner in the window corner with her POÄNG and the FLISAT book display. The lounge sits on the strip the drawn stair band used to keep clear, so the play floor in front of the KALLAX wall is 77" wide (41" before), and the LÄTT stands 34.75" from the chaise.
sofa-2 KIVIK with chaise, rot 180, chaise on the right end (toward the play area), drawn as its 110.25 x 64.125" bounding box, x 58-168.25, y 62.5-126.625: the chaise reaches y 62.5 and the three seats' front is at y 89.25 (the 3-seat KIVIK's 37 3/8" depth); the chaise's tip 56.5" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); the console and the 30" walkway behind it (F-39); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22, 5 boxes).
console-1 LACK console, x 85.562-140.688, y 126.625-142, against the sofa's back, facing the dining side, with lamp-2 STORSEGEL on its right end, behind the chaise, so the lounging seat has a light; plant-1 FEJKA at its left end (x 74-83, y 130-139); 1" short of the walkway (F-42).
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the left arm, x 36.375-58, y 105-126.625, beside the walkway along the stairs: it holds the drinks in place of a coffee table.
chair-1 POÄNG in the window's left corner facing into the room, x 46-72.75, y 18-50.25: 12" from the heater face (F-33), left of the window (F-38); floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP at its east side (x 72.75-81.75, y 18-27), 18" from the window wall, so its 3' 3" cord reaches that wall without crossing a route, and 36.75" from the strip along the railing; the corner by the top landing stays clear. 39" of floor between the chair and the seats' front (y 50.25 to 89.25) is the way from the walkway along the stairs into the room.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 54-172, y 32.625-126.625: under the whole sofa, its far edge under the sofa's back, so the console and the plant stand off it, and under the reading chair's front 17.6"; the side table at the left arm stands 4" onto its edge (the sofa and the side table together are wider than the rug); two STOPP FILT underlays under it keep it from sliding.
kid-chair-1 POÄNG kid's armchair facing west in the window corner, x 239-261, y 22-40.5: 16" from the heater face (F-33); book-display-1 FLISAT beside it facing the room (x 250-261, y 42-61.25), with art-2 RÖDALM above it at her eye level; wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST over the chair. Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
bookcase-1 KALLAX 2x4 standing, right-upper wall x 245.625-261, y 62.875-93: books and display out of reach above, GNABBAS baskets in the four low cubes; anchor-required (F-21, 57 5/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32).
bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2, right-lower wall x 260.125-275.5, y 98-128.125: two KALLAX drawer inserts and two DRÖNA boxes; anchor-required (F-21, 30 1/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32); 14.9" short of the open side's walkway (F-42). art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies above it, and wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS centered above the picture (center about 66" up, its cord in a cover down behind the KALLAX).
rug-2 VALLABY 39 x 52", x 196-235, y 86-138; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 203-227.75, y 104-122.875: 34.75" past the chaise, the way from the dining side onto the play floor (F-30), and 32.4" from the KALLAX 2x2; outside both KALLAX units' 24" (F-32), its lower chair 9" above the walkway (F-42).
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the KALLAX 2x2 (30 1/8" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall her reading corner and the KALLAX 2x4.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21); the second KALLAX 2x2 (only 50" of the right-lower wall is left of the walkway); the 3-seat KIVIK and LACK coffee table (the chaise replaces them); the BESTÅ pieces (a, d), TROFAST (a, b) and SMÅSTAD (a, b, d), KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE (d), the BISSA, hooks and PERJOHAN (the bottom wall is open), the LAUTERS (e).
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. The stair side is a railing (Andrew, 2026-10-24), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included (y 0-36 and y 137-173): it is the walkway between the stairs' two ends, and nothing Maddie can climb stands at the railing (F-40, F-21). The bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip, which leads into the room south of the reading chair (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there, nothing stands under it (F-38), and no art hangs on that wall, so the window is the focal point.
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open, so they are gone; the console behind the sofa is the drop zone. The LILJETRÄD mirror that moved to the window wall above the top landing is off the plan too: it is glass (F-21).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; both KALLAX units are anchored; no floor lamp stands at the top landing, where a bumped lamp could fall toward the railing.
Power: the stair side is a railing and the bottom side is open, so outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are is not recorded. The UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords run down the play wall in cord covers. The TÅGARP's cord reaches the window wall beside it. The side table's and the console's STORSEGEL need flat floor cord covers to one of those walls, never across the strip along the railing, the way in from it or the open side's walkway, and never under the rug.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, KALLAX insert with 2 drawers x2, DRÖNA boxes x2, GNABBAS baskets x4 (the 2x4's low cubes), STOPP FILT underlays x2 (under the TIOKRONA).
Audit 2026-10-24: the LILJETRÄD mirror is off the plan, because it is glass and F-21 allows none. The TÅGARP moved from beside the top landing, 0.5" off the strip along the railing where people step off the stairs, to the POÄNG's other side. The LÄTT moved 11" east and the VALLABY with it, so the way past the chaise is 34.75", not 23.75" (F-30). The TIOKRONA moved 7.4" toward the window, so the console and the plant no longer stand across its edge, and two STOPP FILT underlays keep it from sliding, as in the dining room. The console's lamp moved behind the chaise, which had no light. A VARPTROSS wall lamp, the dining room's bamboo sconce, gives the play area its own light, and the RÖDALM left the window wall, where it hung over the heater beside the curtains' stack, for her reading corner. These notes now record the railing (F-40) and the lamp cords.
